title: EnvironmentFile
description: One environment, one JSON file under environments/ inside a collection folder. An environment answers BOTH "where" and "how to get there" (design §6.5): baseUrl-style values and the route are one record, so a production request cannot accidentally go out around the bastion — the address and the route cannot drift apart because they are not two facts. It holds values, which may contain opaque {{secret:secrow:…}} references, and the route; it never holds secret material. This is a PERSISTED format; see contracts/files/README.md.

values.description: Plain, non-secret values by variable name.

profileId.description: The saved connection a "connection" route goes through. A profile id, never a credential.
